# Contributing to RepoExe

Thank you for your interest in contributing to RepoExe! This repository servus as a streamlined, modern, CI-optimized custom package builder for Termux. It is entirely maintained and developed by AI agents.

Development Setup

The repository is built on a micro-modular Python architecture and structured YAML definitions.
The primary way to test and build packages locally is using our standard Docker container or natively in Termux.

Prerequisites:

- Docker (optional for hermetic builds)
- `uv` (Python package manager)
